errorCodes.meaning: The issuer is not a network the community holds an acknowledged membership in.
The community has no group registered with the issuer for `role` whose acceptance is in force.

The envelope does not verify: an origin or hop signature fails, the message has expired, the hop chain is broken or out of order, it exceeds the hop limit, its last hop is not addressed to the community's group for `role`, or its last hop was not signed by the issuer. `details.message` says which.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

hops.description: One signed hop per relay step, each by the network that owns the previous hop's group.

message.description: The message, signed by the origin network.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Whether the community passed the message on. Deliberately carries no count of the group's members, so the network does not learn the group's size.

status.description: `delivered`: accepted and passed on to the group's members. `duplicate`: the community had delivered this message before; nothing was sent.

schema.description: A network's delivery of a broadcast envelope to the community's group registered for one of the network's roles. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

role.description: The network's role whose registered community group the delivery addresses.
